mapper.sql: job_id, report_type, job_status AS status, requested_by, city_code, from_date, to_date, granularity, output_file_name, storage_key, file_size_bytes, row_count, attempt_count, error_message, created_at, started_at, completed_at, expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM report_export_job WHERE requested_by = #{requestedBy} AND job_status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')

WITH next_job AS ( SELECT job_id FROM report_export_job WHERE job_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE report_export_job job SET job_status = 'RUNNING', started_at = now(), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, error_message = NULL FROM next_job WHERE job.job_id = next_job.job_id RETURNING job.job_id, job.report_type, job.job_status AS status, job.requested_by, job.city_code, job.from_date, job.to_date, job.granularity, job.output_file_name, job.storage_key, job.file_size_bytes, job.row_count, job.attempt_count, job.error_message, job.created_at, job.started_at, job.completed_at, job.expires_at
mapper.update: UPDATE report_export_job SET job_status = 'SUCCEEDED', storage_key = #{storageKey}, file_size_bytes = #{fileSize}, row_count = #{rowCount}, completed_at = now(), expires_at = now() + (#{retentionSeconds} * interval '1 second') WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND job_status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE report_export_job SET job_status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = now() WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND job_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE report_export_job SET job_status = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= 3 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, started_at = NULL, completed_at = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= 3 THEN now() ELSE NULL END, error_message = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= 3 THEN '报表进程多次中断' ELSE NULL END WHERE job_status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < now() - (#{timeoutSeconds} * interval '1 second')
mapper.select: UPDATE report_export_job SET job_status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE job_status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND expires_at <= now() RETURNING storage_key
